2124599098720268782.en_summary: No, it’s not easy, much less the easiest thing in the world. In the last twelve months, $NVDA’s net cash position has increased by $10 billion despite buying back $64 billion of stock, paying $13 billion in dividends, and spending $3 billion on M&A. Whatever “round tripping” alleged is happening, NVDA simultaneously cleared ~$90 billion in cash during that window.
2124599098720268782.zh_summary: 不，這並不容易，更不用說是世界上最容易的事情。在過去十二個月，$NVDA的淨現金頭寸增加了100億美元，儘管回購了640億美元股票、支付了130億美元股息，並在併購上花費了30億美元。無論所指控的「循環交易」如何，NVDA同時在該期間清理了約900億美元現金。
